description: List recent inventory gate runs and their findings for a project, newest first. Returns { runs: [{ id, gate, status, findings_count, … }], findings: [{ severity, rule_id, message, file_path, node_id, … }] }. Filter by gate (dead_handler | mock_leak | api_contract | crawl | status_claim | spec_drift | orphan_endpoint | unknown_call | schema_drift | code_health) or finding severity (info | warn | error). Read-only. Use to see which CI gates failed on the last crawl; use diff_inventory to compare two commits, or get_inventory for the full snapshot.

gate.description: Only runs of this gate (and their findings).

projectId.description: Project UUID — defaults to configured project (`project_id` is accepted too.)

severity.description: Only findings with exactly this severity.

name: list_gate_findings
title: Gate findings
